facts.fact: A PROCASEF information-systems manager told APS on 16 April 2026 that a system to digitise the whole communal land procedure, from request to title, with applicants able to track their file on the platform, is in a deployment phase and agents were being trained in Thiès.

systems.platform: web platform for communal land deliberations
systems.owner: PROCASEF, Ministry of Finance and Budget
